Dialogue.Text: Well done!^1 Now,^2 the robot won't tell you everything.^1 Thus,^2 it is imperative that you ask about the certain steps the robot made.
You can use the chat box for that.^1 However,^2 watch out,^2 *The Orange Kitten*^2 has already taken precautions in their network.
In a nutshell,^2 you may only send *7 messages* to the robot before the connection may get compromised.^1 You are also limited to only 100 characters.
The health bar on the left helps you keep track.^1 If your lives are out,^2 we shall try tomorrow once more.^1 Though we shall have to tighten your payroll if that happens.
...right. For each statement the robot made,^2 an *insight* might be generated.^1 If you think this insight contradicts with a statement you think is *wrong*,^2 try to present it.
Oh,^2 I need to take this call.^1 Please,^2 proceed with your mission now.^1 I'll get back to you soon.
